title: Sidebar by @GregSarafian: It only takes one layer in Icon Composer to achieve this effect. Just
notes:
It only takes one layer in Icon Composer to achieve this effect. Just make sure to bleed the SVG out of bounds otherwise you may end up with a jarring double specular highlight on the icon’s edges.

Designer: @GregSarafian. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
